#HW 04
```{r hw04}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "data/midwest_airbnb.db")
listings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") 

dplyr::glimpse(listings)

library(dplyr)

listings |> 
  filter(city == "Columbus") |> 
  nrow()
library(dplyr)

listings |>
  filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  arrange(desc(price)) |>
  select(name, price) |>
  head(5) 

chicago <- subset(listings, city == "Chicago")
chicago[which.max(chicago$price), c("name", "price")]

listings |>
  filter(city == "Chicago") |> 
  summarise(n_distinct(neighbourhood))

listings |> 
  filter(host_is_superhost == "t") |>
  nrow()

listings %>%
  filter(price > 1000) %>%
  nrow()
```

# Scout Data
```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(),
                     "../data/scout.db")
DBI::dbListTables(con)
postings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "scout_postings")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
dplyr::glimpse(postings[, c("title", "company",
  "location_state", "remote", "skills_json")])
```

## Assignment 05

```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "data/midwest_airbnb.db")

client = ellmer::chat_openai(
  model = "gpt-5.6-luna",
  params = ellmer::params(reasoning_effort = "none")
)

qc = querychat::querychat(
  con, "listings",
  client           = client,
  tools            = c("filter", "query", "visualize"),
  greeting         = "Ask me about 14,887 Airbnb listings in Chicago, Columbus, and the Twin Cities.",
  data_description = "data/data_desc.md",
  extra_instructions = "data/extra_instructions.md"
)

qc$app_obj()



# Example for an API client function
client = usa_jobs_client(
  api_key = Sys.getenv("USA_JOBS_API_KEY")
)

library(httr2)

req = request("https://data.usajobs.gov/api/search") |>
  req_headers(
    `Authorization-Key` = Sys.getenv("USA_JOBS_API_KEY"),
    `User-Agent`        = "your_email@example.com"
  )

client = ellmer::chat_openai(
  model   = "gpt-5.6-luna",
  api_key = Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
  params  = ellmer::params(reasoning_effort = "none")
)
```
